title: hoop_ask's input: quick questions for a person

label.description: The option as the person reads it

recommended.description: True for the one option you recommend

options.description: Two to four options; exactly one is recommended

context.description: One or two sentences on why it matters

anchor.description: A line in an open review the questions are about; they show beside it on the review's page

review_id.description: The open review the question is about

words.description: Words on the line the question is about, in place of item and line; they must occur once

item.description: The item, with line; or with words, to narrow where they occur. "DOC" is the title, TL;DR and subtitle

line.description: The line: 0 is an item's heading; DOC line 1 is the title, 2 the TL;DR, 3 the subtitle
